_meta.description: Square-root variance-stabilising transform on the skewed transactions.pulse amount column via FEAT_SQRT. Sibling shape to FEAT_LOG (01_log_transform.json) but uses sqrt instead of natural log — appropriate when the distribution carries zero values (log(0) is undefined; sqrt(0) is 0). Summarises the transformed distribution via AGG_AVERAGE + AGG_STDDEV so the shape change is visible as scalars.
_meta.name: feat_sqrt_transform
